# rsync exclude list for TenPennyNovels deployment
# These files/folders will NOT be transferred to OVH VPS

# Dependencies (reinstalled remotely)
node_modules/

# Python virtualenv (regenerated remotely)
venv/
__pycache__/
*.pyc
*.pyo

# Build outputs (generated remotely)
.next/
dist/
build/
out/

# Git and GitHub
.git/
.github/
.gitignore
.gitattributes

# Environment files (already on server, contain secrets)
.env
.env.local
.env.production
.env.*.local
.env.development
.env.test

# Logs (don't overwrite production logs)
*.log
logs/
npm-debug.log*
yarn-debug.log*
yarn-error.log*
pnpm-debug.log*

# Testing
coverage/
.nyc_output/
__tests__/
*.test.js
*.test.ts
*.spec.js
*.spec.ts

# Cache files
.eslintcache
.turbo/
.cache/
*.cache
.parcel-cache/

# OS files
.DS_Store
.DS_Store?
._*
.Spotlight-V100
.Trashes
ehthumbs.db
Thumbs.db
desktop.ini

# Editor files
.vscode/
.idea/
*.swp
*.swo
*~
.project
.settings/

# Temporary files
*.tmp
*.temp
.tmp/
tmp/

# Documentation (not needed in production)
README.md
CHANGELOG.md
LICENSE
*.md
docs/

# Development only
.prettierrc
.prettierignore
.editorconfig
tsconfig.tsbuildinfo

# Claude Code
.claude/

# Pricing docs (not needed in production)
pricing/
 
# Deployment configs (already on server or not needed)
ecosystem.config.js
docker-compose.yml
Dockerfile
.dockerignore

# Deploy state (managed on server)
.deps-hash
.deploy-state

# Runtime-generated sitemaps (written by SitemapService: deploy pipeline step
# + daily 03:00 cron). Not in the repo — with --delete rsync would wipe them
# on every deploy, causing a 404 until the next successful generation.
apps/landing/public/sitemap.xml
apps/documents/public/sitemap.xml

# Local AI Folder
local-ai/
